init_BaseTracker: create a BaseTracker instance with optional momentums dict and num_frames_retain parameter
update_tracker_tracks: call update on BaseTracker with ids and frame_ids kwargs to add or update object tracks
get_tracker_buffer: call get on BaseTracker with item name and optional ids to retrieve buffered track data
crop_imgs_for_reid: call crop_imgs on BaseTracker to crop image regions by bounding boxes for re-identification
reset_tracker_state: call reset on BaseTracker to clear all tracks and reset the tracker buffer
